title: The Sleeping Old Lilly
subject: English Language
objectives: Read and understand a story about friendship

blocks.alt: Two old men sitting outside a hut
blocks.caption: Mark and Lilly have been friends for many years.

blocks.md:
Mark and Lilly have lived in the same street for over thirty years. Now they both are seventy years old, and now they talk about the good things they have done for their town.

One day, there was a heavy rain in the village. Mark thought that his friend, Lilly had gone to the farm. He rushed off to the farm without checking if Lilly was at home. But Lilly had been enjoying his sleep at home while Mark was searching for him all over the farmlands. In his bid to find where his friend was, Mark started shouting, 'Lilly, where are you?' He called so loudly that all the villagers ran out under the heavy rain because they thought that the flood had carried Lilly away.

The noise of the villagers and of Mark woke Lilly from his deep sleep. Lilly was angry and he told all the villagers that he had gone to heaven in his sleep and was talking with God when their noise woke him up. And the villagers were also very angry with Lilly.

quiz.q: How long have Mark and Lilly lived on the same street?
quiz.explain: The story says over thirty years.

quiz.q: Why did Mark run out in the rain?
options: To find Lilly at the farm
quiz.explain: He thought Lilly was at the farm.
